newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics to unveil new technology.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics to unveil new technology.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Tuesday it will unveil at a briefing scheduled for Wednesday in New York what it said is "one of the most exciting technologies" it has ever developed, but declined to provide details.
While the company withheld details, analysts speculated it will introduce a modem with 56 kilobit per second transmission capabilites, much faster than existing speeds.
"I think it's the 56-K modem," said John Grangaard, an analyst for GS2 Securities. "It gives them a strong upgrade cycle on both the client end and the server."
Shares of U.S. Robotics were up 7-7/8 at 77.

U.S. Robotics, whose modems for telecommunications connections hold the largest market share, said in a statement that it "will unveil one of the most exciting new technologies ever to be developed by U.S. Robotics". It said it will also announce broadbased strategic alliances.
The news briefing will be held on October 16, at 1200 EDT in New York. Casey Cowell, U.S. Robotics' chairman, chief executive and president, will be there to answer questions, the company said.
Other executives will be available in Chicago, San Francisco and Boston, where the briefing will be held via satellite feed. A live Internet broadcast will also be available.
